title: Wi-Fi setup
chooseLead: Pick the network this device should join.
hiddenLead: Enter the name of a hidden network and its password.
openLead: This network is open; no password is needed.
channelWarning: Your phone may lose its connection to this device for a moment. Stay on this page: it reconnects and shows the result.
saveAnywayHint: Use this if the network is out of range right now. The device keeps trying to connect.
doneLead: The device is now on your network. You can close this page and reconnect your phone to your usual Wi-Fi.
savedLead: The device keeps trying to connect to this network. You can close this page and reconnect your phone to your usual Wi-Fi.
lostLead: Connect your phone to the device's Wi-Fi network again and reload this page. If the device connected to your network, its own Wi-Fi network is gone and setup is done.

reasons.wrong-password: The password is wrong. Check it and try again.
reasons.network-not-found: The network wasn't found. Check its name, and that it's in range.
reasons.timeout: The network didn't answer in time.

errors.ssid-too-long: A network name is at most 32 bytes.
errors.ssid-invalid: A network name can't contain a NUL character.
errors.password-too-short: A Wi-Fi password has at least 8 characters.
errors.password-too-long: A Wi-Fi password has at most 63 characters, or 64 hex digits.
errors.password-invalid: The password may only use letters, digits, spaces and the usual symbols; 64 characters must be hex digits.
errors.busy: The device is still testing the previous network.
errors.done: The device is already set up.
errors.not-saved: The device couldn't save the network.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach the device. Make sure your phone is still on its Wi-Fi network.
errors.management-password-invalid: A management password has 8 to 63 characters: letters, digits, spaces and the usual symbols.
errors.management-password-mismatch: The two passwords aren't the same.
errors.unreachableManagement: Couldn't reach the device. The values below may be out of date.
errors.actionFailed: The device didn't accept this. Reload the page and try again.
errors.full: The device can't keep more networks. Remove one first.
errors.last-network: This is the device's only network. To forget it, use Network Reset on the Device tab.
errors.not-found: That network isn't saved any more. The list has been updated.
errors.position: The device didn't accept the new order. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid-character: This contains a character that isn't allowed.
errors.out-of-range: This number is outside the allowed range.
errors.not-a-checkbox: The device didn't accept this. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rejected: The device didn't accept this value.
errors.unknown-setting: The device didn't accept this. Reload the page and try again.
errors.not-stored: The device couldn't save this. Try again.

resetReasons.brownout: After the power dropped too low

managementLead: Choose a password for this device's management page, which you open later from your own network.
managementKeepLead: A management password is set already. Leave both fields empty to keep it, or enter a new one.
managementLater: To manage the device later, open http://{ip}/ from your own network and log in as {user}.
savedNetworksLead: The device uses the first network on this list that's in range. Add another one, or change the order.
orderHint: The device uses the first network on this list that's in range.
listFull: The device keeps up to {max} networks. Remove one to add another.
addNetworkLead: The device saves it without testing it, so check the name and password. It's used when no network above it is in range.
removeLead: The device forgets this network and its password. If it's connected to it now, it stays connected until that connection ends.

restart.title: Restart
restart.confirm: The device restarts and is back on the network after a few seconds. Its settings are kept.
restart.done: The device is restarting. Reload this page in a few seconds.

settingsReset.title: Settings Reset
settingsReset.confirm: All settings go back to their defaults, including any this page doesn't show. Wi-Fi networks and the management password are kept.
settingsReset.done: The settings are back to their defaults.

networkReset.title: Network Reset
networkReset.confirm: The device forgets every Wi-Fi network it knows and leaves this one. To use it again, join its own Wi-Fi network and set it up from there. Everything else is kept.
networkReset.done: The device has left this network. Join its setup Wi-Fi network to connect it again.

factoryReset.title: Factory Reset
factoryReset.confirm: Everything stored on the device is erased: Wi-Fi networks, the management password and all other settings. It then restarts as if new. This can't be undone.
factoryReset.done: The device is erasing everything and restarting. Join its setup Wi-Fi network to set it up again.

settingsLead: Set up this device. Changes are saved when you press Save.
keepPassword: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
daylightSavingHint: Untick to keep the standard time all year.
installConfirm: The device downloads {version}, checks it and restarts with it. It's offline for a moment while it restarts.
doNotPowerOff: Do not power off the device.

outcomes.pending: Installed, waiting for the new firmware to confirm
outcomes.rolled-back: Rolled back to the previous firmware

updateErrors.http-status: The update server answered with an error.
updateErrors.manifest-invalid: The update server's description of the update isn't valid.
updateErrors.too-old: This version is too old to update to the new one directly.
updateErrors.no-space: The update doesn't fit on the device.
updateErrors.low-memory: The device has too little free memory right now.
updateErrors.unsigned: The device has no key to check updates with.
updateErrors.size-mismatch: The download has the wrong size.
updateErrors.signature-invalid: The update isn't signed by the device's maker.
updateErrors.rolled-back: The new firmware didn't start properly, so the device went back to the previous one.
updateErrors.busy: The device is busy with an update.
